answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks 120 coins, twice 30-day earnings, in escrow before trading. Its fingerprint, timed by a quartz clock during walnut sorting, cannot be replayed by a clone. A swarm over the same knoll of cheap tasks loses escrow on re-verification. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 coins, far above their diluted reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
